issues.issue: Result states DOR was evaluated among 11 patients, but the citation quote 'Duration of Response N=11' means 11 responders (the number with a response), not patients evaluated for DOR; the phrasing misstates the population.

companion_dx.present is false but the detail text and citation describe a genuine patient-selection biomarker requirement (H3 K27M mutation) with no approved test; the present/detail flags are internally inconsistent.

Orphan Drug Designations cited are for 'glioblastoma' and 'malignant glioma', not the approved diffuse midline glioma H3 K27M indication; supported by the quote but note the designation mismatch relative to the actual indication.

Detail asserts the drug was 'approved on August 6, 2025, ahead of the goal date' as evidence of first-cycle approval, but no citation supports that this was a single review cycle with no complete-response letter; the first_cycle=true conclusion is not directly supported by the quotes.
